Changes The goal bonus, in contract renewals and transfer offers, steps up by 10 million lire. The sporting director no longer lists players above his average cap. At 4 stars the cap is 85. events.title: Calcio 98 0.52.4 (2026-10-24)
events.summary: Changes The goal bonus, in contract renewals and transfer offers, steps up by 10 million lire. Fixes Continue takes you to the next match even when it is more than a week away, and shows how far the calendar has advanced. If the cloud save fails, the game stays saved on the computer and a notice appears. A completed signing no longer stays in the open negotiations. To send feedback, email game@calcio98.com. We try to reply to every message we receive.

events.title: Calcio 98 0.52.3 (2026-10-18)
events.summary: Fixes Fixed Steam achievements when multiple accounts use the same PC: unlocks and wins now follow the active Steam account. Temporary synchronization errors are retried without counting the same win twice. To send feedback, email game@calcio98.com. We try to reply to every message we receive.

events.title: Calcio 98 0.52.2 (2026-10-01)
events.summary: Fixes Accepting a new club or renewing in later seasons now keeps the correct year instead of resetting the calendar to 1998. In leagues that finish in July, the final matchdays, calendar and history now stay in the correct season until the actual season change. Moving to the next season no longer gets stuck while regenerating the youth pool. Playoffs in CPU-controlled divisions now complete correctly, keeping promotions and English league sizes consistent. To send feedback, email game@calcio98.

events.title: Calcio 98 0.52.0 (2026-09-29)
events.summary: Fixes Moving to the next season starts correctly: the calendar and shirt numbers stay in place. On the transfer market, computer-run clubs stay at 17 players or more and cannot sell their last goalkeeper. To send feedback, email game@calcio98.com. We try to reply to every message we receive.

events.title: Calcio 98 0.51.0 (2026-09-20)
events.summary: Improvements In the browser, careers that were started but never saved are now cleaned up automatically. If a game is no longer available, a message appears before returning to the home screen. Fixes The calendar no longer skips your team's matches: overlapping fixtures move to the first free day, while newly discovered overdue fixtures return to the current date. Lineups remove players who are no longer in the squad and prevent duplicate starters when replacing unavailable players. Financial up

events.title: Calcio 98 0.50.0 (2026-09-17)
events.summary: What's New In the browser, name customizations imported from Excel are remembered for your account and applied to new games. You can restore the original names for future games from Options. Existing saves keep their current names. Changes The browser now includes the compressed public database with the game, replacing the previous paged download when starting a career or championship. If you want to send feedback, write to game@calcio98.com. We try to reply to every message we receive.

events.title: Calcio 98 0.49.2 (2026-09-15)
events.summary: What's New Account verification and password reset emails now arrive in your selected game language: Italian, English, German, Spanish, or French. If you use an email account, you can now reset your password from the sign-in screen. The email link is valid for one hour. In the browser, the game loads data from the server and saves your progress online. The Steam version still works offline. events.title: Calcio 98 0.48.0 (2026-09-10)
events.summary: What's New At the start of the season, CPU squads are topped up (at least 16 players and a goalkeeper). Changes Matches between two CPU teams are faster (result from team averages and scorers). In the browser the game uses less memory after simulations and does not reload the page. Fixes Continue: the starting XI is ready before kick-off; European cups and the end-of-season review no longer get stuck. CPU matches in July stay in the current season. events.title: Calcio 98 0.47.1 (2026-09-07)
events.summary: What's New On Steam, the game recognises you at launch: you are already signed in to your Calcio 98 account. Talking to the game server is protected: the client rejects tampered responses. Fixes In matches (and for the opponent on the dashboard, header, calendar and stadium) kits use the same database colours, not the wrong tints. If you want to send feedback, write to game@calcio98.com. We try to reply to every message we receive.

basic_info.short_description: Calcio 98 is a single-player football management game set in the 1998/99 season and created by longtime fans of the classics like Premier Manager 98 or PC Fútbol 7. Lead your club across 18 leagues and 14 cups through tactics, transfers, squad development and finances.
